[1] Estate of the artist [1887–1986] (Santa Fe, New Mexico, USA); [2] 1993, Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation (Abiquiu, New Mexico, USA); [3] December 26, 1997, purchased by Jane Bradley Pettit Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) and gift to Milwaukee Art Museum (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1], [2] Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven, CT: Yale University Press; Washington, DC: National Gallery of Art; Abiquiu, NM: The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, 1999), p. 97, cat. 156. 
[3] Agreement in MAM object file 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Verso inscription 1 and Abiquiú Notebooks date 1916. Completed after August move to Texas. Pictured in 1917 New York (291) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 9. See cat. nos. 135–55, 157–62. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Date listed as 1916/1917 in the Lynes publication.
